sloka: ततः पितरि स्वर्याते पौरा मामभ्यषेचयन् ।तत्राहं कृतवान्राज्यं धर्म्यं च सुसमाहितः ।। ७.७८.५ ॥
transliteration: tataḥ pitari svaryāte paurā māmabhyaṣecayan ।tatrāhaṁ kṛtavānrājyaṁ dharmyaṁ ca susamāhitaḥ ।। 7.78.5 ॥

translations.english: Then, when my father had passed away to heaven, the citizens consecrated me, and I diligently performed righteous kingship there.
